findings.description: Reentrancy in batchMint: external calls nftMinter.mint(_dispatcherIndex, recipient) (line 258, in a loop) execute before the NudgePaid event is emitted (line 284). Event-only reentrancy: the nudge balance read (balanceOf at line 269) and the nudge safeTransfer occur after the mint loop, so a reentrant/malicious minter or ERC1155 receiver callback could re-enter batchMint between the mints and the nudge payout. batchMint has NO nonReentrant guard. Within the story-015 flow this is the path to scrutinize: the minReward check (line 280) and balanceOf read (line 269) sit downstream of the untrusted mint loop. Note tokenMinter is owner-pinned (trusted by design), which is the primary mitigation, but recipient-side ERC1155 onERC1155Received callbacks during mint remain attacker-controlled.

Return value of nftMinter.mint(_dispatcherIndex, recipient) is ignored inside the count loop. If the trusted minter's mint() returns a status/token-id rather than reverting on a no-op, ignoring it could let mints silently no-op while the caller still clears the nudge gate. Mitigated in part by the contract docs stating a faked/mismatched paymentToken reverts the real mint() and rolls back the batch; relevant to verify against ITokenMinterV2.mint semantics.

Tuple return of INFTMinterV2(address(nftMinter)).configs(_dispatcherIndex) is partially ignored: only the first element (dispatcher) is destructured; the remaining three fields are discarded. Low practical impact here (only dispatcher is needed to derive primeToken), flagged for completeness.

Local variable nudgeAmount (declared line 269) is never explicitly initialized. It defaults to 0 and is only assigned inside the nudge-eligibility branch, so when the nudge is disabled/threshold not met it correctly stays 0 and the minReward floor check (nudgeAmount < minReward) treats it as zero reward. Behaviorally correct as written, but the story-015 minReward guard depends entirely on this default-zero semantics being intentional; worth confirming no path reads nudgeAmount before the conditional assignment. Aderyn flags the adjacent declaration at line 257.
